title: IBM Storage Scale 5.2.3.0 through 5.2.3.8, and 6.0.1.0 does not validate or improperly validates TLS certificate…
description: IBM Storage Scale versions 5.2.3.0 through 5.2.3.8, and 6.0.1.0, have a vulnerability where TLS certificates are not properly validated during communication with remote cluster GUI interfaces. This flaw could allow an attacker to perform man-in-the-middle attacks and inject forged JSON responses.
